summary.oneLiner: A Noida-based IVD and medical-device manufacturer providing affordable diagnostic kits, reagents and analysers to labs, hospitals and government buyers in India and overseas.
summary.business: Avience Biomedicals Limited, established in 2019, is a medical-consumable company that manufactures in-vitro diagnostic (IVD) products and medical devices from its facility in Noida, Uttar Pradesh. Its range spans IVD rapid test kits (VTM, Covid, HIV, HBsAg, Malaria, Dengue and others), serology products, biochemistry analysers, biochemistry reagents and culture media. It sells B2B, B2C and B2G to pathology/microbiology labs, hospitals and research centres nationwide and to export markets, and also acts as a distributor/trader of medical equipment.
